name: robots/openai__multi-agent-emergence-environments
title: OpenAI Multi-Agent Emergence Environments Base (MuJoCo)
intro: OpenAI Multi-Agent Emergence Environments Base (MuJoCo), adapted from openai/multi-agent-emergence-environments. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
